q.line: While his daughter hid and watched
stanza: And led him to the lonesome hill
While his daughter hid and watched
She dared not breathe she was so still
Just as the angel cried for the slaughter

partner.line: Just as the angel cried for the slaughter

q.line: I want you to know that while we watched
stanza: We pointed you the way to go
And scratched your name in sand
Though you just thought it was nothing more
Than a place for you to stand
I want you to know that while we watched
You discovered no one would be true
That I myself was among the ones who thought
It was just a childish thing to do

partner.line: That I myself was among the ones who thought
